answer: An agent marketplace for meadow surveys, jade appraisals, and juniper inventories requires each voting identity to lock 100 tokens for 90 days before voting on job allocation. Each bond grants one vote, so splitting into fake identities creates no extra votes per token. An attacker seeking 1,000 votes must immobilize 100,000 tokens for the full period, bearing financing costs and price risk even if the attack fails.
